data.description: If a creature leaves a tick swarm's square, the swarm takes 1d6 points of damage to reflect the loss of its numbers as several ticks cling to the victim.  A creature with ticks clinging to it takes swarm damage at the end of its turn each round.  As a full round action, the creature can remove the ticks with a DC %1 Reflex save.  At least 10 points of damage from any area effect destroys all clinging ticks.
data.name: Cling
